description: Start an FAQ page from a group of questions, like Add to FAQ in the app. featury writes the draft in the background from the product's public material and spends the organization's credits like any page the help center writes. The page stays a draft until a person publishes it in the app or you call publish_help_article, which refuses a page with no answer yet. To write the answer yourself, edit it with update_help_article. Calling this again for the same group returns the same page. Needs a help center that is being set up or is live. MANAGER+ required.
